record.field: Perform automated operating system patch management
Odoo ships security fixes in its regular builds. Shield reads the build date from the version string and compares it against published advisories for this series and the installed modules.
Pull the latest build of your series (e.g. docker pull odoo:18.0, or update the source checkout) in a staging-first window, then upgrade modules.
No public attachments on business documents
Attachments flagged public can be downloaded by anyone who has or guesses the URL, without logging in. Invoices, contracts and employee files should never be public.
Untick "Is public document" on the listed attachments (Settings > Technical > Attachments) and find the module or user that set it.
Chatter messages hold Odoo's audit trail (who changed an IBAN/CBU, who posted a bill). Shield logs every deletion on audit-relevant records and flags messages removed from records that still exist.
Ask the user why; restore context from Shield's deletion log and the database backups; review that user's other changes in the same period.
The SHA-256 chain proves nobody edited past assessments, but only while the chain itself survives. Emailing each seal to an outside mailbox makes even a full rewrite of the history provable.
Set the system parameter shield.seal_recipients (comma-separated emails, e.g. your auditor) and configure an outgoing mail server.
